verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents an automation that detects failed CI workflows, inspects logs, identifies the likely cause and opens a PR with a proposed fix (docs-9). Supporting evidence covers automations triggered by webhook events with GitHub integration (gh-4), GitHub-workflow SDK guides (docs-20), API support for scripting (docs-13) and auto-approve for unattended runs (docs-3). The failed-workflow automation is described only in a one-line marketing blurb. missing for 10: detailed docs on wiring OpenHands into CI pipelines (e.g. a GitHub Action or pipeline step config), coverage of CI systems beyond GitHub, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the fix-failing-build flow works.
